intro: You will compare a research summary with a popular claim and separate data, inferences and limits.

piezas.titulo: Summary of a study and a newsletter (fictional texts)

frases.estudio: En fiktiv undersøkelse fulgte et samtaletilbud på et bibliotek i åtte uker.
frases.alumno: A fictional study followed a conversation group at a library for eight weeks.

frases.estudio: Av 57 deltakere svarte 42 på spørreskjemaet etter perioden.
frases.alumno: Of 57 participants, 42 answered the questionnaire at the end of the period.

frases.estudio: Flere av dem rapporterte at det var blitt lettere å stille spørsmål på biblioteket.
frases.alumno: Several of them reported that it had become easier to ask questions at the library.

frases.estudio: Studien hadde ingen sammenligningsgruppe og målte ikke endringer i språkferdigheter.
frases.alumno: The study had no comparison group and did not measure changes in language skills.

frases.estudio: Et fiktivt nyhetsbrev skriver likevel at tilbudet forbedret norsken til alle deltakerne.
frases.alumno: However, a fictional newsletter claims that the activity improved the Norwegian of all participants.

frases.estudio: Rapporten gir ikke grunnlag for å slå fast en slik årsakssammenheng.
frases.alumno: The report does not provide a basis for establishing such a causal relationship.

texto: When evaluating a text, distinguish what was measured, who took part and what the source concludes. **Undersøkelsen tyder på …** («The study points to…») is more cautious than asserting a cause. If there was no comparison group, a change cannot be safely attributed to the course or intervention described.

A faithful synthesis can set a claim beside its basis: **Nyhetsbrevet hevder …, men rapporten måler bare …** («The newsletter claims…, but the report only measures…»). Avoid turning a limitation into proof that the opposite result is true.

pregunta.texto: Which data did the fictional study actually measure?

opciones.explicacion: The summary reports 42 responses from 57 participants.

opciones.texto: The language improvement of all the people
opciones.explicacion: The summary says no changes in language skills were measured.

opciones.texto: The difference compared with a control group
opciones.explicacion: The study had no comparison group.

pregunta.texto: Complete «points to» with a cautious phrasing.

frase.texto: Undersøkelsen ___ at det ble lettere å stille spørsmål.

opciones.explicacion: **Tyde på** means points to or suggests.
It means proves; that would be a stronger claim than the data described.

frase.texto: Rapporten gir ikke grunnlag for å slå fast en årsakssammenheng.

opciones.texto: The report does not provide a basis for establishing a causal relationship.
opciones.explicacion: The wording states a limit of the evidence.

opciones.texto: The report proves that no relationship exists.
opciones.explicacion: Being unable to establish causation doesn't show that it doesn't exist.

opciones.texto: The newsletter offers a complete scientific explanation.
opciones.explicacion: The newsletter is the one making the general claim, not the report.

pregunta.texto: Write a synthesis of 80–100 words that contrasts the newsletter's claim with the data and mentions a limitation. Attribute the claims to their source.

textos: Det fiktive nyhetsbrevet hevder at samtaletilbudet forbedret norsken til alle deltakerne. Rapporten gir et mer begrenset bilde: 42 av 57 svarte etter åtte uker, og flere rapporterte at det var lettere å stille spørsmål på biblioteket. Dette viser hva noen deltakere opplevde, men ikke om språkferdighetene ble bedre. Studien målte ikke slike ferdigheter og hadde ingen sammenligningsgruppe. Det er også uklart hvordan de som ikke svarte, ville ha vurdert tilbudet. Derfor gir materialet ikke grunnlag for å slå fast at tilbudet forårsaket en generell språkforbedring. En forsiktig konklusjon skiller mellom rapporterte erfaringer og målbare læringsresultater.

piezas.explicacion: Criteria: summarise both sources, distinguish stated opinion from measured skill, attribute each claim and don't overstate what can be concluded. The model is not the only valid answer.
